name: Office (a332), Section 6

observations.note: bldg in good condition. structural inspection every 5 yrs by PE civil, report to BCA

planned preventive + predictive maint by 3rd party LEWs. annual IR thermography LT/HT boards, transformers, DBs, risers. annual shutdown maint, PD test + DGA on transformers, annual load test gensets, quarterly no-load test, annual lightning test. bldg opened 2025 so first DGA/PD test due Jun 2026
lifts, chillers, AHUs maintained by contractors per manufacturer recommendation
FP impairments managed with an isolation form only. no formal impairment programme

service contract w 3rd party for FP equipment. annual dry riser servicing, monthly fire pump service + test run, monthly wet riser pumps, monthly smoke detector testing (100% every 5 yrs), monthly FA servicing, quarterly VESDA, quarterly water monitors. servicing report needs improving
underground bulk diesel tank tops up day tanks of 3 gensets. day tanks bunded, leak detection to FCC. diesel piping in 2hr containment. licensed under SCDF petroleum & flammable materials licence
housekeeping generally good in areas inspected
hot work permit system w checklist - 11m combustible clearance, fire watch during and after hot work
MOC involves the different stakeholders, risk assessment conducted
ERP for fire, bomb threat, pandemic. 6-man ERT (site mgmt controller, site incident controller, 4 ERT from maint + security) both shifts. min 2 fire drills a year
facility technicians do daily morning inspections
smoking prohibited on site, well enforced - no cigarette butts seen anywhere
all contractors go through site-specific induction before any work
BCA Green Mark Platinum Super Low Energy certified
